notes: Under the corresponding hypothesis observations have its product law.

role: simple statistical hypothesis
notes: The two specified laws exhaust the simple-hypothesis comparison.

role: observation density against the common measure
notes: Finite-score third-law calculations require positive finite density versions under that law.

role: finite-history joint density
notes: Product of the observation densities in the independent model; the dependent extension uses actual joint densities.

role: observed-history likelihood ratio
notes: One-sided zero densities yield zero or infinity and terminate the implemented test.

role: observed information at stage m
notes: An explicit independent randomization seed may be included at the initial stage.

role: one-observation log likelihood score
notes: Finite almost surely for equivalent laws; singular observations stop before any opposite infinity is added.

role: cumulative log likelihood score
notes: The sum is used only with finite scores or before an immediate singular decision.

role: partition into two terminal regions and continuation
notes: Regions are measurable in the observed finite history.

role: first terminal stage
notes: Possibly infinite until termination is proved; equality at either boundary stops.

role: terminal binary decision
notes: Zero chooses the null and one chooses the alternative.

role: terminal decision event
notes: Here these are subsets of stopped histories; their local type differs from a probability law.

role: actual error probabilities of the chosen procedure
notes: They need not equal the prescribed targets.

role: prescribed type-I and type-II error targets
notes: Nominal and conservative calibrations have different exact guarantees.

role: prior probabilities of the exhaustive simple hypotheses
notes: They are positive and sum to one.

role: posterior correct-decision thresholds
notes: Each exceeds one half; these are posterior levels rather than frequentist errors.

role: upper and lower likelihood-ratio boundaries
notes: The original general rule has zero less than B less than A; the practical calibration scope has B below one and A above one.

role: logarithms of the upper and lower boundaries
notes: The upper log boundary is positive and the lower one negative in the declared practical calibration scope.

role: affinity of the two observation laws
notes: Strictly below one for distinct laws; separate from the source exponential excess constant.

role: mean one-observation score under the selected law
notes: Division by this mean is used only when it is nonzero.

role: actual upper-terminal probability under the selected law
notes: Under a third law it is the operating characteristic at that law.

role: finite positive score variance in the centered stopping identity
notes: The centered score has second moment equal to this variance.

role: nonnegative lower and upper boundary overshoots
notes: Defined on their respective terminal decision events.

role: conditional mean lower and upper overshoots
notes: A zero-probability terminal event contributes zero.

role: upper mean excess and signed lower mean excess of one score
notes: The prime retains the source negative signed convention; finite extrema are explicit assumptions.

role: exponential moment of one score
notes: For complex t existence means absolute integrability of the real-part exponential.

role: nonzero real exponential root
notes: A root is assumed or proved for the specific family; zero drift may leave only the zero root.

role: one-step multiplicative exponential excess extrema
notes: These quantities bound terminal exponential overshoot; they are not the affinity.

role: operating-characteristic boundary approximation
notes: Obtained by neglecting both exponential overshoots; its zero-root expression is an algebraic limit.

role: integer magnitudes of the extreme lattice score increments
notes: Both endpoint masses are positive in the lattice construction.

role: upper ceiling and lower floor lattice boundary levels
notes: The rounded boundaries encode the unchanged real score exit criterion.

role: probability of one integer score value
notes: A finite probability mass sequence used in the root equation.

role: possible terminal lattice score value
notes: The listed lower and upper exit bands include all overshoots.

role: nonzero complex root of the lattice equation
notes: Multiplicity is retained; a repeated row can make the source determinant singular.

role: root coefficient matrix and its column replacement
notes: Cramers rule is asserted only for a nonzero determinant.

role: finite set of continuing lattice sums
notes: It contains the starting sum zero.

role: probability expectation and upper-exit probability from starting sum x
notes: The start is a specified continuing lattice state.

role: substochastic continuing-state transition matrix
notes: Its absorption series converges by a uniform block exit probability.

role: one-step upper and lower exit probability vectors
notes: Together with the continuing matrix they determine exact absorption and stopping-time transforms.

role: positive and negative Bernoulli score values
notes: Both values are finite for interior and separated Bernoulli parameters.

role: Bernoulli null alternative and third-law parameters
notes: The two hypotheses satisfy zero less than p0 less than p1 less than one.

role: normal hypothesis half-separation and third-law mean
notes: The hypothesis means are minus d and d with variance one.

role: standard normal density and distribution function
notes: Distinct from the score exponential moment written varphi.

role: standard normal u-quantile
notes: This indexed role is a quantile; the lattice probability masses use index j.

role: minimum fixed normal sample size for the prescribed errors
notes: Integer ceiling is retained; the separate sequential saving formula neglects overshoot.

role: exact conditional stopping-time exponential transforms
notes: Their convergence domains are explicit; restriction to an imaginary argument gives characteristic functions.

role: exact unconditional stopping-time exponential transform
notes: Its mixture weights are the actual terminal probabilities.

role: boundary approximations to the conditional transforms
notes: Use the approximated operating characteristic consistently for normalization at zero.

role: boundary approximation to the unconditional transform
notes: The solved two-root expression is not a discrete stopping-time error guarantee.

role: stopping-time transform argument
notes: Real arguments give exponential transforms and imaginary arguments give characteristic functions.

role: selected roots for the two-boundary transform system
notes: Local branches tend to zero and the nonzero score exponential root.

role: two-root transform coefficient determinant
notes: At a zero denominator a justified limit is required.

role: continuous one-sided stopping-time approximation density
notes: Its normalization and moments are proved; no unproved discrete-to-continuous error bound is claimed.

role: scaled continuous stopping size and its positive density parameter
notes: Here m is the declared continuous scaling variable rather than a finite inspection-stage index.

role: forced finite-horizon terminal decision
notes: The zero-score tie accepts the null after the original continuation condition.

role: normal score mean and variance under the specified hypothesis
notes: The exact finite-horizon score has mean N times mu and variance N times the single-score variance.

role: actual errors of the capped procedure
notes: Bounds add a new terminal interval probability to the actual uncapped errors.

role: independent uniform result for a fixed one-observation inspection
notes: Independence is specific to the calculated repeated-inspection counterexample.

role: number of repeated fixed-sample inspections
notes: An integer horizon; the root coefficient matrix uses a calligraphic symbol.

role: actual errors of a competing sequential procedure
notes: The information lower bounds use these actual errors at the same strength.

role: binary information numerator for the chosen test
notes: The bounded-excess theorem compares expected cost with its universal information lower bound.

role: absolute bound on a single score increment
notes: In this result it bounds each terminal conditional score interval width.

role: normal upper-tail probability and hazard ratio
notes: Proof-local functions used to derive both excess extrema and tail-ratio monotonicity.

role: auxiliary Gaussian integral for the density normalization
notes: A proof-local integral; it is not an observation information field.

role: complex modulus of the score exponential transform
notes: Typed complex modulus in the stopped-transform premise; no cardinality role is intended.

role: real absolute value of the observation score
notes: This typed absolute value supplies the integrability premise for Walds stopped-sum identity.
